Clients representing these families can make an appointment or walk in to meet with one of our social workers regarding crisis intervention, nutrition, legal assistance, benefits and entitlements and other referrals. They will then help the client through the process or refer them to the proper course of action. They will also see if there are any other services that we offer that can be of assistance to the client. Follow up will be done if necessary.
